## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/mabel-colby--nell-harcourt.md)

Mabel Colby and [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) are close friends and driven scholars who attend Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy) together. They navigate their academic rivalry alongside their friendship while balancing their studies as exams draw near.
